*The boars of the Thyme Banks have been charging the road patrol's horses. Thin them out, then find Aylwin of the road patrol and see that he is whole.*

## Objectives

1. Defeat 30 [Downs Boar](../monsters/downs_boar.md) in [The Thyme Banks](../maps/thyme_banks.md)
2. Talk to [Aylwin](../npcs/aylwin.md)

## Rewards

- 4,300 EXP
- 460 mesos
- [Orange Potion](../items/orange_potion.md) x10
- +15 standing with Selsior
- +100 standing with [Elinor](../npcs/elinor.md)
